key_idea: The three transformations form the Klein four-group, so only the parity of 'vertical flips' and 'horizontal flips' matters (r toggles both).
sketch: Deduce the letter maps from the samples: h reverses the string and swaps b<->d, p<->q; v keeps the order and swaps b<->p, d<->q; r is the composition of both. Count the parity of each generator over t (r toggles both), then apply at most one in-place letter swap and one reverse-with-swap to s. O(|s|+|t|). Pitfall: the naming is counter-intuitive (h is the flip that reverses the string), so check against the samples rather than trusting the words.
